title: MV Skill checks inspired by Tabletop RPG s

posts.author: Harven
posts.body:
Hello I need a plugin for RPG Maker MV that would allow me to make skill checks similiar to those from Tabletop RPGs like Dnd.
I need some way to show the player their stats and bonuses and also the required number to pass a check with a simple UI before and after the check.
It would also be nice to have a simple animation of a die while doing the check.
I'm ready to pay if someone would do that for me
Below some mockup images to showcase excatly what I need because I'm not that good with words:

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Frogboy has a suite of plugins designed to emulate D&D features in MV.
Frogboy MV
frogboymv.github.io
His Talent Core is what you'd want to look at - it doesn't show a die roll, but it does offer a gauge on the screen to show the skill check.
